title: First agreements with the tall whites: speak English, sing to announce himself

tellings.quote: agreement I made with them was after realizing they were real that I asked him that whenever they came around me that they talk between themselves.

plain: Charles Hall says that from 1965 to 1967, while working in the desert near Indian Springs, Nevada, he met tall, pale non-human beings he calls the tall whites. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that once he accepted they were real, he made agreements with them: they would talk among themselves in English whenever they were near him, and he would sing to announce he was coming. If true, it would mean humans and aliens were living side by side, by agreement, on a US military range.
